subject: CAutomobile -- complete field layout from VALIDATE_OFFSET + Capstone sweep
_note: CAutomobile inherits CVehicle (0x5A0). Own range 0x5A0..0x987 (1000 bytes). 53 fields from VALIDATE_OFFSET (disassembly/game_sa/CAutomobile.h) cross-verified by Capstone sweep of 13 anchor functions. m_nAutomobileFlags@0x868 documented as 8-bit bitfield (bTaxiLight..bIsMonsterTruck). Structural pads: 0x869(1B after flags), 0x963(1B after m_nNumDriveWheelsOnGroundLastFrame), 0x982-3(2B after m_fireParticleCounter). eCarNodes enum (25 nodes) and eWheelState enum (4 states) documented inline.
provenance: cold disassembly of gta_sa.exe (1.0 US); names from disassembly CAutomobile.h VALIDATE_OFFSET macros; bitflags from CAutomobile class body declarations

fields.name: m_damageManager
fields.note: Vehicle damage state manager. 24B struct tracking panel/door/wheel damage.

fields.name: m_doors
fields.note: Door physics array (6 doors x 24B each = 144B). Indices: 0=RF, 1=RR, 2=LF, 3=LR, 4=bonnet, 5=boot.

fields.name: m_aCarNodes
fields.note: RwFrame* pointers for all 25 car model nodes (see eCarNodes enum). CAR_NUM_NODES=25, 25x4B=100B. Indices: CHASSIS=1, WHEEL_RF=2..LB=7, DOOR_RF=8..LR=11, BUMP_FRONT=12, BUMP_REAR=13, WING_RF=14, WING_LF=15, BONNET=16, BOOT=17, WINDSCREEN=18, EXHAUST=19, MISC_A..E=20..24.

fields.name: m_panels
fields.note: Bouncing panel physics array (3 panels x 32B each). Hood, trunk, and bumper deformation physics.

fields.name: m_swingingChassis
fields.note: CDoor instance used for swinging chassis physics (buses, certain trucks).

fields.name: m_wheelColPoint
fields.note: Collision contact point per wheel (4 wheels x 44B CColPoint = 176B). Wheels: RF=0, RB=1, LF=2, LB=3.

fields.name: m_fWheelsSuspensionCompression
fields.note: Per-wheel suspension compression ratio: 0.0=fully compressed, 1.0=fully relaxed.

fields.name: m_fWheelsSuspensionCompressionPrev
fields.note: Previous frame suspension compression (used for spring velocity).

fields.name: m_fWheelCounts
fields.note: Per-wheel contact force / ground-reaction counter.

fields.name: m_fBrakeCount
fields.note: Braking force accumulator for this frame.

fields.name: m_fIntertiaValue1
fields.note: Inertia value 1 (typo in original: 'Intertia'). Used in wheel pair processing.

fields.name: m_fIntertiaValue2
fields.note: Inertia value 2. Used in wheel pair processing.

fields.name: m_wheelSkidmarkType
fields.note: Skid mark type per wheel (4 x 4B int). 0=none, 1=normal, 2=mud, etc.

fields.name: m_bWheelSkidmarkBloody
fields.note: Per-wheel: skidmark should be bloody (ran over a ped).

fields.name: m_bWheelSkidmarkMuddy
fields.note: Per-wheel: skidmark should be muddy (driving on soft ground).

fields.name: m_fWheelRotation
fields.note: Per-wheel spin angle (radians, accumulated).

fields.name: m_fWheelPosition
fields.note: Per-wheel bounce position along suspension axis.

fields.name: m_fWheelSpeed
fields.note: Per-wheel rotation speed (rad/frame). Used for audio and skidmark logic.

fields.name: m_fWheelBurnoutSpeed
fields.note: Per-wheel burnout speed target (unused in normal SA gameplay).

fields.name: m_nAutomobileFlags
fields.note: Packed automobile behaviour bitflags (8 flags in 1 byte). Bit 0: bTaxiLight, Bit 1: bShouldNotChangeColour, Bit 2: bWaterTight, Bit 3: bDoesNotGetDamagedUpsideDown, Bit 4: bCanBeVisiblyDamaged, Bit 5: bTankExplodesCars, Bit 6: bIsBoggedDownInSand, Bit 7: bIsMonsterTruck.

bitfields.name: bTaxiLight
bitfields.desc: Taxi light on (requires SetTaxiLight or m_sAllTaxiLights)

bitfields.name: bShouldNotChangeColour
bitfields.desc: Suppress colour change when remapping texture

bitfields.name: bWaterTight
bitfields.desc: Vehicle does not take water ingress damage

bitfields.name: bTankExplodesCars
bitfields.desc: Collisions with other vehicles cause explosions (tank behaviour)

bitfields.name: bIsBoggedDownInSand
bitfields.desc: Vehicle is currently stuck in soft ground

bitfields.name: bIsMonsterTruck
bitfields.desc: Monster truck (extra traction + ground clearance logic)

fields.name: m_bDoingBurnout
fields.note: Burnout state counter. Non-zero = vehicle is currently doing a burnout.

fields.name: m_wMiscComponentAngle
fields.note: Current misc component angle (cranes, spinning parts). In fixed-point.

fields.name: m_wMiscComponentAnglePrev
fields.note: Previous frame misc component angle (for interpolation).

fields.name: m_dwBusDoorTimerEnd
fields.note: Game time (ms) when bus doors finish opening/closing.

fields.name: m_dwBusDoorTimerStart
fields.note: Game time (ms) when bus door animation started.

fields.name: m_aSuspensionSpringLength
fields.note: Natural (rest) spring length per wheel from handling data.

fields.name: m_aSuspensionLineLength
fields.note: Total suspension line cast length per wheel.

fields.name: m_fFrontHeightAboveRoad
fields.note: Front axle centre height above road surface (from CWorld::ProcessVerticalLine).

fields.name: m_fRearHeightAboveRoad
fields.note: Rear axle centre height above road surface.

fields.name: m_fExtraTractionMult
fields.note: Traction multiplier override (cheat/script injection point).

fields.name: m_fNitroValue
fields.note: Nitro boost value / tyre temperature accumulator.

fields.name: m_fAircraftGoToHeading
fields.note: Target heading for TellPlaneToGoToCoors/TellHeliToGoToCoors.

fields.name: m_fRotationBalance
fields.note: Controls destroyed helicopter rotation (angular momentum).

fields.name: m_fMoveDirection
fields.note: Previous speed (used as move direction parameter).

fields.name: m_vecMoveForce
fields.note: Accumulated move force vector applied this frame.

fields.name: m_vecTurnForce
fields.note: Accumulated turn/torque force vector applied this frame.

fields.name: m_aDoorRotation
fields.note: Door rotation angles for 6 doors (unused in SA -- doors use CDoor physics).

fields.name: m_fBurningTimer
fields.note: Fire countdown: starts when health < 250.0; vehicle explodes at 5000.0.

fields.name: m_pWheelCollisionEntity
fields.note: Per-wheel: entity the wheel is in contact with (NULL if no contact).

fields.name: m_vWheelCollisionPos
fields.note: Per-wheel: world-space contact point position.

fields.name: m_pExplosionVictim
fields.note: Ped caught in explosion radius (set during explosion processing).

fields.name: field_92C
fields.note: 24 bytes of unknown purpose. May contain animation state or physics scratch.

fields.name: m_fLeftDoorOpenForDriveBys
fields.note: Left door open ratio for drive-by shooting (0.0=closed, 1.0=fully open).

fields.name: m_fRightDoorOpenForDriveBys
fields.note: Right door open ratio for drive-by shooting.

fields.name: m_fDoomVerticalRotation
fields.note: Vertical rotation for Doom-style aircraft gun targeting.

fields.name: m_fDoomHorizontalRotation
fields.note: Horizontal rotation for Doom-style aircraft gun targeting.

fields.name: m_fForcedOrientation
fields.note: Forced heading for helicopter (set by SetHeliOrientation; -1.0 = disabled).

fields.name: m_fPropRotate
fields.note: Propeller rotation angle (previously m_fUpDownLightAngle[0]).

fields.name: m_fCumulativeDamage
fields.note: Accumulated crash damage for deformation visuals (previously m_fUpDownLightAngle[1]).

fields.name: m_nNumContactWheels
fields.note: Number of wheels currently in contact with ground.

fields.name: m_nWheelsOnGround
fields.note: Wheels-on-ground bitmask or count (used by GetNumContactWheels).

fields.name: m_nNumDriveWheelsOnGroundLastFrame
fields.note: Number of driven wheels touching ground last frame (for burnout/traction logic).

fields.name: m_fGasPedalAudioRevs
fields.note: Gas pedal audio revs multiplier: adjusts skid sound playback speed (0.0..1.0).

fields.name: m_wheelState
fields.note: Per-wheel state enum (4 x 4B int32). WHEEL_STATE_NORMAL=0, SPINNING=1, SKIDDING=2, FIXED=3.

fields.name: m_pNitroParticle
fields.note: Nitro exhaust FxSystem pointers (left=0, right=1). NULL if inactive.

fields.name: m_harvesterParticleCounter
fields.note: Frame counter for harvester combine particle spawning.

fields.name: m_fireParticleCounter
fields.note: Frame counter for fire particle spawning.

fields.name: m_heliDustFxTimeConst
fields.note: Time constant for helicopter dust effect intensity scaling.
